onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

PoleInTime.Description: Start of Sample period (in seconds, relative to trial start time)

PoleOutTime.Description: Start of Delay period (in seconds, relative to trial start time)

CueTime.Description: Start of Response period (in seconds, relative to trial start time)

GoodTrials.Description: 0 for trials in which mice are not performing, discard for analyses

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
